_comment_courses: List specific course names to sync (partial match, case-insensitive). Example: ['CS341', 'MATH237']. Leave empty [] to sync ALL enrolled courses.
_comment_extensions: Only download files with these extensions. Example: ['.pdf', '.pptx']. Leave empty [] to allow ALL file types.
_comment_exclude_folders: Skip any D2L module/folder whose name contains one of these strings (case-insensitive). Example: ['Archive', 'Old Material'].
_comment_dry_run: Set to true to see WHAT WOULD BE synced without actually downloading or uploading anything. Great for a first test run.
_comment_overwrite: Set to true to re-upload files even if they are already recorded in state.json. Useful if you want to force-refresh everything.
_comment_onedrive_root_folder: Top-level folder name created in your OneDrive. Avoid special characters like / \ : * ? " < > |
_comment_temp_dir: Local directory for temporarily storing downloaded files before they are uploaded to OneDrive. Cleaned up automatically.
_comment_max_file_mb: Skip files larger than this size in megabytes. Protects against filling GitHub Actions runner disk (typically 14GB). Set to 0 to disable the limit.
